title: Planner outline routing drops assigned facts from the returned slots and reports no unplaced facts
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
At d1425291, real stdio MCP plan_deck(format="deckspec", template="blue-corporate", brief="Create 5 slides. Slides: title, executive summary, market chart, recommendation, next steps. Revenue is EUR 212m. EBITDA is EUR 31m. Margin is 14.6%."). Call 19 in tests/quality/results/mcp-audit-20261007/calls.jsonl.

Actual: all three facts disappear from slots[].facts and deck_spec; unplaced_facts=[] and budget_note says Nothing was cut. This also drops the revenue, EBITDA and margin sentence from the eight-slide Nordbolt test (calls 6,17). A using agent following the promised routed facts loses the business baseline without any warning.

## Root Cause
internal/deckplan/deckspec_plan.go:outlineDeckSpecSlots calls body, appendix := o.splitAppendix() BEFORE o.routeRest(rest). splitAppendix in outline.go copies outlineItem structs and their facts slice headers. routeRest appends facts to o.items and marks them placed, but ordered is then built from the stale body/appendix copies. Those copies retain the old slice lengths even when the append shares backing storage. The planner suppresses unplaced_facts for facts it never returns.

## Deduplication
Related closed xbwlt and hf8tf address named-slide extraction/fact preservation; this is a distinct, current reproducible copy-before-mutation defect in outline routing. Non-outline control call 18 retains the revenue sentence. Evidence includes exact requests/responses, not a claim inferred from older reports.
acceptance: Route facts before copying outline items, or preserve shared routing state. End-to-end tests must assert each of EUR 212m, EUR 31m and 14.6% occurs in the returned slots or unplaced_facts. Cover both body and appendix items, multiple appended facts, and insufficient capacity. Verify the actual public plan response, not only mutations to the private outline.

title: Planner mistakes chart data after a singular slide label for a deck outline
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
Current-source stdio MCP at d1425291. Call 17: plan_deck(format="deckspec", template="blue-corporate", brief="Create an 8-slide board proposal named Nordbolt diligence. Revenue EUR 212m and EBITDA EUR 31m imply a 14.6% margin. A regions slide shows a bar chart of the market: 2021 EUR 8.1bn, 2025 EUR 9.4bn, 2028 forecast EUR 10.6bn on the left and our 2.3% share on the right. Ask: CFO approves scope on Friday.").

Actual: two stat slides for 2021 and 2025, followed by a chart_insight for 2028; no regions slide. budget_note claims the brief has a three-item outline. Full fixture call 6 then leaves Compare scope B/C unplaced. Control call 18 changes the singular slide label to A chart shows the market and keeps all three years on one chart. Call 20 replaces the colon with with and also stops the false outline branch.

## Root Cause
internal/deckplan/outline.go:outlineHeader matches the singular word slide anywhere in a label. parseInlineOutline sets labelled when a non-first sentence contains that word, and its labelled branch accepts the list without the numeric-list checks used by outlineCountMatches. Thus an instruction about one slide is interpreted as an instruction enumerating the whole deck. It strips the chart's contextual label and promotes data rows into slides.

## Scope / Deduplication
This is independent of the fact-copy bug: fixing returned facts alone still leaves the wrong chart decomposition. Related closed xbwlt is named-slide routing, not this false-positive grammar. Preserve legitimate explicit Slides:/Outline: lists. Evidence: tests/quality/results/mcp-audit-20261007, calls 6 and 17-20.
acceptance: Distinguish deck outline labels from data lists belonging to a singular slide. Keep 2021/2025/2028 together and honor the requested regions composition. Add regressions for chart, bridge and KPI lists after singular slide labels, with commas and semicolons; retain explicit plural Slides:/Outline: and numbered slide lists.

title: Quantitative comparisons omit meta.source and bypass DATA_WITHOUT_SOURCE
description:
## Steps to Reproduce
At d1425291 through real stdio MCP, render source-default-args.json in tests/quality/results/mcp-audit-20261007. It is one comparison slide, columns Scope B/C with 25 interviews, EUR 320k/EUR 410k and 4/5 weeks, meta.source="Illustrative procurement estimates". Call 22 returns deterministic_ready=true with no source finding. PPTX slide XML and rendered pixels contain no source. Original eight-slide deck reproduces on blue-corporate and modern-template (slide 5).

Controls: call 23 adds the same string as slides[0].source and a visible source appears exactly once. Call 24 omits every source; no DATA_WITHOUT_SOURCE finding. Calls 27/28 render the default and explicit controls. The missing disclosure makes synthetic or estimated commercial figures appear unattributed even though the agent supplied the deck source correctly.

## Root Cause
cmd/json2pptx/fit_findings_source.go uses slideDataKind for both applyDeckSourceDefault and collectDataWithoutSourceFindings. patternDataKind recognizes a fixed list of chart/KPI patterns and numeric text-scale table-highlight, but never examines numbers in comparison-2col (or the alternate comparison panel/card renderings). CompileComparison emits comparison-2col, so both default source inheritance and missing-source detection skip it.

## Deduplication / Scope
Closed 1jtn7 fixes quantitative option_matrix/table-highlight; q2emv fixes grid tables. Those fixes do not cover comparison-2col. Explicit per-slide source works. Keep wholly qualitative comparisons exempt; inspect data-bearing comparative figures rather than adding source footers to every text slide. This report does not claim source loss for the bridge: a larger rendering confirmed that source exists.
acceptance: For quantitative comparisons, inherit meta.source exactly once, preserve explicit override precedence, and emit a semantic-path DATA_WITHOUT_SOURCE finding when neither exists. Test two-column and multi-column rendering paths plus qualitative controls. Visually verify default and explicit sources on blue-corporate and modern-template, with takeaway/footer clearance.
